attributes.title: 2027 MPA Annual Convention & Exposition
attributes.series: Michigan Pharmacists Association Annual Convention & Exposition
attributes.summary:
The Michigan Pharmacists Association holds its 2027 Annual Convention & Exposition (ACE) in person from April 16 to 18, 2027, at the Lansing Center in downtown Lansing. MPA plans the program for pharmacists, residents, pharmacy technicians and student pharmacists from all practice settings, and the convention usually draws more than 700 people.

Continuing education is one of the stated goals of the meeting, alongside an exhibit hall, networking, a poster session and the association's awards. Session proposals are being reviewed until mid-December 2026, so the program, CE hours and registration fees are not published yet. MPA is reserving a room block at the DoubleTree next to the Lansing Center.
